latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of geo-metrics-tracker: a skill for real-time GEO performance metrics monitoring and alerting.

- Provides a framework to track, visualize, and react to key metrics like AIGVR, SoM, AI citation volume, and coverage across major generative AI engines.
- Focuses on designing system schemas, tracking plans, dashboards, and alert rules (not direct data extraction).
- Supports anomaly detection, ongoing dashboards, and operational routines for continuous observability.
- Intended to complement `geo-report-builder` by turning static reports into live, actionable monitoring systems.
- Includes detailed guidance on metric definitions, system integration, and workflow steps for teams setting up GEO metric tracking and alerting.
